summary: Bind saved Trip reads to private verified snapshots and canonical SQLite writes.
reason: The generated immutable reader ignores committed WAL and lazy SQLite path opens can select a substituted inode. Alias and unescaped URI paths can also lose or misdirect saved observations. Source wrappers refuse ambiguous caches and preserve ordinary SQLite write transactions.
validated_outcome: Focused actual CLI/MCP tests reject active committed WAL, preserve pinned snapshot rows across lazy path substitution, retain ordinary canonical/symlink writes, and refuse hard-link or URI wrong-file mutation. SQLite runtime reports patched 3.51.3.
